title: Group action-stabilizer graph of group actions of a group on a set
summary: In this paper we introduce the group action-stabilizer graph $GAS(G)$ of a group $G$ on a set $X$ with vertex set as the collection of all the group actions of $G$ on $X$, and any two vertices $φ$ and $ψ$ are adjacent if and only if the non-trivial subgroups $\cap G_x^φ$ and $\cap G_x^ψ$ of $G$ intersect non-trivially, where $G_x^φ$ and $G_x^ψ$ are two stabilizers of $x$ with respect to the actions $φ$ and $ψ$, respectively. We characterize a special subgraph $gas(G)$ of $GAS(G)$ in which the vertex set contains the actions $φ$ of $G$ on $X$ such that $\cap G_x^φ$'s are distinct. We…
